newsitem.title: FINLAND: J.TALLBERG BUYS REAL ESTATE FOR FIM 20 MLN.
newsitem.headline: J.TALLBERG BUYS REAL ESTATE FOR FIM 20 MLN.

text.p: Finnish real estate investment company Julius Tallberg-Kiinteistot Oy said on Monday it had bought a property in Vantaa for 20 million markka with the potential to strengthen growth in its asset value per share.
"Among other things, the potential to utilise the (property's) building right will for its part strengthen growth in the company's asset value per share," Julius Tallberg-Kiinteistot said.
It bought the property from Kodak Oy, which has a long-term lease for parts of the office, warehouse and production building on the site.
